answer.rationale: The incumbent’s refusal to reopen price this cycle may not preclude non-price concessions. Memory_c4 shows benchmarking against market rates previously moved the incumbent on both price and payment terms, while memory_c6 confirms multi-year volume commitments unlocked cost reductions without narrowing service scope. With 14 days to expiration and an 18% spend cut mandate, negotiating improved payment terms, volume discounts, or other TCO levers offers the only path to meet finance’s target without the delivery risk of switching vendors (memory_c2 required onboarding) or the supply disruption risk of deferring (memory_c5). This balances cost pressure with continuity.
